subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a right circular cylinder is 616 cm² and the area of its base is 38.5 cm². What is the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder? (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Volume** of a **cylinder** = **Base Area** × **Height** (h)

**Base Area** = 38.5 cm² ⇒ πr² = 38.5 ⇒ r = 3.5 cm

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 2πrh = 616 ⇒ 2 × (38.5/r) × h = 616

⇒ h = (616 × 3.5) ÷ (2 × 38.5) = 28 cm

**Volume** = 38.5 × 28 = 1078 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1078 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8808f38fce80315332fa63eed3692801f57c4ae4b390fdfdf7c9353b410f609a.png] 

**Given:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 616 cm²

**Base Area** = 38.5 cm²

**Formula Used:**

⇒ **Base Area** = πr²

⇒ **CSA** = 2πrh

⇒ **Volume** = πr²h

**Calculations:**

⇒ πr² = 38.5

⇒ (22/7) × r² = 38.5

⇒ r² = (38.5 × 7) ÷ 22 = 1.75 × 7 = 12.25

⇒ **r** = √12.25 = 3.5 cm

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 × h = 616

⇒ 2 × 22 × 0.5 × h = 616

⇒ 22 × h = 616

⇒ **h** = 28 cm

⇒ **Volume** = 38.5 × 28 = 1078 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1078 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

It is the sum of CSA and the areas of the two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).

Hollow Cylinder Volume

For a hollow cylinder with external radius R and internal radius r, Volume = π(R² − r²)h.

Ratio of CSA to Volume

For any cylinder, the ratio of its Curved Surface Area to its Volume is 2/r.</p
